# `delonix` image/build — parity defects and correction prompts

**Source:** live functional test, parameter by parameter, of the image/build domain
— `build`, `pull`, `push`, `tag`/`untag`, `rmi`, `images`, `save`/`load`,
`export`/`import`, `commit`, `history`, `login`/`logout`, `search` — against
`docker`/`podman`.
**Environment:** delonix 0.1.2 (commit `8a795077`), rootless host · daemonless,
`alpine:3.19`, multi-stage Dockerfile with `ARG`/`LABEL`. Docker 29.10.0 /
Podman 4.9.3. Date: 2026-11-19.
**Method:** observed effect — content generated by `--build-arg`, layer by
`--target`, re-execution by `--no-cache`, `save`↔`load` and
`export`↔`import` round-trip (recovered file), live `search` on Docker Hub.

**Verdict:** the **build core** is solid and comes with supply-chain extras (`--secret`,
`--provenance`) that Docker does not ship by default. 7 defects, all **parity** issues
with scripting/multi-arch/metadata flags (none break the build happy path).

Attack order: security → functionality → parity → DX.

---

## Per-parameter matrix (observed)

| Verb / parameter | Observed effect | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `build -t` / `-f` / `--build-arg` | image created; `cat /greeting.txt` = `built-with=hello-parity` | ✅ parity |
| `build --target <stage>` | stopped at the stage; `/stage.txt` absent | ✅ parity |
| `build --no-cache` | RUN re-executed | ✅ parity |
| `build --secret` / `--provenance` | present (supply-chain) | ✅ (extra) |
| **`build --label` / `--pull` / `-q` / `-o`** | `unexpected argument` | ❌ **I1** |
| `images -q` / `-o json` | ids; structured JSON | ✅ parity |
| **`images --filter` / `--format`** | `unexpected argument` | ❌ **I4** |
| `tag` / `untag` | alias created/removed | ✅ parity |
| `history` | `LAYER / SIZE` table | ⚠️ partial |
| **`history --no-trunc`/`-q`/`--format` + CREATED BY column** | absent | ❌ **I5** |
| `save -o` → `load -i` | round-trip: image recovered | ✅ parity |
| `export -o` → `import` | round-trip: `/marker.txt` = `imported-data` | ✅ parity |
| `commit <ctr> <tag>` | image created | ✅ parity |
| **`commit -m` / `-a` / `-c` / `-p`** | `unexpected argument '-m'` | ❌ **I3** |

## Cross-cutting notes
- **Rootless host, no sudo**; `/tmp` ephemeral between turns. Tests: `cargo test -p delonix-bin --bins`.
- New flag → **pt.po** (3 texts) + flag order (`delonix-new-code-and-flag-gates`).
- `push`/`login` to a real external registry were not exercised (no credentials) — only the parser/local path.

---

## I1 — `build` missing `--label`/`--pull`/`-q`/`-o`/`--cache-from`  _(Medium · parity)_

**Symptom.** `build --label k=v` and `build -q` → `unexpected argument`. `BuildArgs`
(`bins/delonix/src/cmd/build.rs:88`) has `-f/-t/--build-arg/--no-cache/--secret/
--platform/--target/--provenance`, but it lacks what CI uses: `--label` (OCI
metadata), `--pull` (force base refresh), `-q/--quiet` (only the final id), `-o/--output`
(export the result), `--cache-from`.

**Correction.** Add to `BuildArgs`: `--label <k=v>` (repeatable → image's `config.Labels`),
`--pull` (ignore the cached base), `-q/--quiet` (suppress the log, print only
the id), and evaluate `-o/--output` + `--cache-from`.

**Done when.**
1. `build --label a=b -t x .` → `inspect x` shows `a=b` in the labels.
2. `build -q -t x .` → prints only the id, without the step log.
3. Test covering label + quiet.

**Gates.** New flags → **pt.po** + order. Rootless gates. **Agent:** general-purpose, medium tier.

---

## I2 — `pull` missing `--platform`/`-q`/`-a`  _(Medium · parity/multi-arch)_

**Symptom.** `pull --platform linux/amd64 alpine` → `unexpected argument`. `build`
has `--platform`, but `pull` does not — on a multi-arch host you cannot pull a
specific variant. Also missing are `-q/--quiet` and `-a/--all-tags`.

**Root cause.** `PullArgs` (`bins/delonix/src/cmd/image.rs:214`) only exposes `--verify`;
`cmd_pull` (`image.rs:810`) has signature `(reference, verify)` — no platform.

**Correction.** Add `--platform <os/arch[/variant]>` (selects the OCI index entry),
`-q/--quiet` (only the digest) and `-a/--all-tags`.

**Done when.**
1. `pull --platform linux/arm64 alpine:3.19` pulls the arm64 variant (verifiable in
   `inspect`/manifest) on an amd64 host.
2. `pull -q` prints only the digest.
3. Test of the platform selector.

**Gates.** New flags → **pt.po** + order. Rootless gates. **Agent:** general-purpose, high tier (OCI index/manifest).

---

## I3 — `commit` missing `-m`/`-a`/`-c`/`-p`  _(Medium · parity/metadata)_

**Symptom.** `commit -m "msg" <ctr> <tag>` → `unexpected argument '-m'`. The commit
works (creates the image), but it does not accept a message, author, `--change`
instructions or `--pause` — Docker's `commit <ctr> <tag>` accepts them all.

**Root cause.** `cmd_commit` (`bins/delonix/src/cmd/container.rs:6667`) has signature
`(images, store, id, tag)` — no metadata fields.

**Correction.** Add to the `Commit` variant and to `cmd_commit`: `-m/--message`,
`-a/--author` (→ history/config), `-c/--change <Dockerfile-instr>` (applies `CMD`/`ENV`/
`LABEL`/… to the new image's config) and `-p/--pause` (freezes the container during the commit).

**Done when.**
1. `commit -m "x" -a "me" <ctr> t` → `history t` / `inspect t` show message+author.
2. `commit -c 'CMD ["sh"]' <ctr> t` → `inspect t` shows the new CMD.
3. Test of message + change.

**Gates.** New flags → **pt.po** + order. Rootless gates. **Agent:** general-purpose, medium tier.

---

## I4 — `images` missing `--filter`/`--format`/`--digests`/`--no-trunc`  _(Low · parity/scripting)_

**Symptom.** `images --filter dangling=true` and `images --format '{{.Repository}}'` →
`unexpected argument`. `-o json` exists; Docker's `--format` Go-template, `--filter`,
`--digests` and `--no-trunc` are missing.

**Correction.** Add to the `images`/`image ls` args (`bins/delonix/src/cmd/image.rs`):
`--filter <k=v>` (`dangling`, `reference`, `label`), `--format <template>`, `--digests`,
`--no-trunc`. Reuse the `-o json` model.

**Done when.** `images --filter dangling=true` lists only the dangling ones; `images --format
'{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}'` prints refs; test covered.
**Gates.** New flags → **pt.po** + order. **Agent:** general-purpose, medium tier.

---

## I5 — `history` missing CREATED BY column and `--no-trunc`/`-q`/`--format`  _(Low · parity)_

**Symptom.** `history <img>` shows only `LAYER / SIZE`; `docker history` shows
`CREATED / CREATED BY / SIZE / COMMENT` (each layer's instruction is the most
useful information). Flags `-q`, `--no-trunc`, `--format`, `-H` absent.

**Root cause.** `cmd_history` (`bins/delonix/src/cmd/image.rs:859`) prints only
digest+size.

**Correction.** Add the CREATED BY column (layer instruction, read from the OCI config
`history[]`) and the flags `-q` (only ids), `--no-trunc`, `--format`.

**Done when.** `history <img>` shows each layer's instruction; `history -q` only ids;
test covered.
**Gates.** New flag → **pt.po** + order. **Agent:** general-purpose, low tier.

---

## I6 — `search` missing `--filter`/`--format`/`--no-trunc`  _(Low · parity)_

**Symptom.** `search --limit N <term>` works (live), but Docker's `--filter stars=3`,
`--format` and `--no-trunc` are missing.

**Correction.** Add `--filter` (`stars`, `is-official`, `is-automated`),
`--format <template>` and `--no-trunc` to the `search` args.

**Done when.** `search --filter is-official=true alpine` only officials; test covered.
**Gates.** New flags → **pt.po** + order. **Agent:** general-purpose, low tier.

---

## I7 — `rmi` removes only one image; `import` missing `-m/-c`; `login` missing `-p`  _(Low · parity/DX)_

**Symptom.** `rmi <a> <b>` → usage error (accepts only a singular `<IMAGE>`; docker/podman
remove several). `import` missing `-m/--message`/`-c/--change`/`--platform`. `login` missing
`-p/--password` (likely a **deliberate divergence** — `--password-stdin` is the secure
path; keep it).

**Correction.** (a) `rmi` should accept `Vec<IMAGE>` and remove in batch (continue on errors,
aggregated rc). (b) `import` should accept `-m`/`-c`/`--platform`. (c) `login -p`: do **not**
add without the owner's decision — the secure default is preferable.

**Done when.** `rmi a b c` removes the three (rc reflects partial failures); test covered.
**Gates.** Arity change → **pt.po** + order. **Agent:** general-purpose, low tier.

---

## What is NOT a defect (parity confirmed live)
- **build core**: `-f`/`-t`/`--build-arg` (content verified), `--target` (correct
  stage), `--no-cache` (RUN redone); `--secret` and `--provenance` are **supply-chain
  extras** (Docker needs buildx for the equivalent).
- `images -q`/`-o json`; `tag`/`untag`; `save`↔`load` and `export`↔`import` round-trip;
  basic `commit`; live `search --limit`; `pull --verify` (signature);
  `login --password-stdin` (secure path).
